documentation.title: Jakarta EE 9+ namespace (javax to jakarta)
documentation.content: Spring Boot 3.0 moves from Java EE to Jakarta EE 9/10 APIs. Imports such as javax.servlet, javax.persistence, javax.validation and javax.annotation (for example javax.annotation.PostConstruct) must change to jakarta.servlet, jakarta.persistence, jakarta.validation and jakarta.annotation. Code that still uses the javax packages fails to compile with errors like "package javax.persistence does not exist" or "cannot find symbol". Third-party libraries must also be versions built for Jakarta EE 9+.

documentation.title: Spring Boot 3.1
documentation.content: Spring Boot 3.1 adds Testcontainers service connections (@ServiceConnection) and Docker Compose support (spring-boot-docker-compose). It upgrades to Hibernate 6.2. Dependency management for Apache HttpClient 4 was removed, so a project that still uses HttpClient 4 must declare its version explicitly or the build fails to resolve it.
